## Requirement

* PHP >= 8.5
* Composer >= 2.0

## Installation

```shell
git clone ...
cd swiss-knife/
composer install --no-dev --ansi -v
# 配置相关环境变量...
composer app:install-project
```

## Usage

## Composer scripts

```shell
composer checks:artisan
composer checks:optional
composer checks:required
composer php-cs-fixer:fix
composer ecs:fix
composer test
```
